correctness.rationale: Every factor is sorted by number of marked ones and endpoints; the two-marker forms have exactly one zero-gap inequality, making the set and count complete. An exact lattice count gives the finite CDF, and a normalized simplex integral gives the limit CDF and moments. Special case m=0, strict inequalities, extremizer multiplicities and the O(n) moment remainder are explicit. Independently implemented finite factor enumeration, cumulative frequencies and rational moment checks passed, but these are corroboration of an all-length symbolic proof, not an exhaustive proof.

value.rationale: The mathematical object—distinct Abelian-unbordered factors of finite words—is motivated directly by Abelian border/periodicity research, and exact conditional behavior at the minimal nontrivial fixed composition was not implied by inspected literature. The result resolves all gap parameters and word lengths, both extremal configurations, the exact finite law and a nondegenerate piecewise-quadratic scaling law with an explicit second-order fluctuation coefficient. The statistical classification is a coherent structural invariant rather than a routine increment or unmotivated finite table.
